question: Does the NASA/JPL close-approach table contain replicated hard internal contradictions in distance bounds, gravitational speed ordering, or calendar/JD identity?
claim_boundary: A pass is a public-catalog consistency candidate. It is not anomalous asteroid motion or new physics.
normal_model: Every row must satisfy dist_min <= dist <= dist_max; encounter speed v_rel cannot be below asymptotic speed v_inf; and the formatted calendar time must agree with Julian date to within the calendar field's one-minute resolution.
dominant_confound: Rounding, time standards, limit semantics, or misunderstood API fields can imitate a violation; provider definitions must be checked before promotion.
dataset_version: NASA/JPL SBDB Close Approach Data API v1.5 local snapshot
unit_of_analysis: one row with finite dist, dist_min, dist_max, v_rel, v_inf, jd, and parseable cd
discovery_split: SHA-256 first byte of des + '|' + jd is even
confirmation_split: SHA-256 first byte of des + '|' + jd is odd

primary_statistics.distance_order: dist_min <= dist <= dist_max with 1e-15 AU tolerance
primary_statistics.time_identity: absolute difference between parsed cd UTC and JD-converted UTC <= 60 seconds

controls.positive: 1000 valid synthetic rows, with 100 independently injected bound, speed, or two-minute calendar/JD contradictions; at least 99 of 100 injected rows must be identified
controls.negative: 1000 valid synthetic rows spanning 1900-2200; at most 1 may be flagged

multiple_testing: Three frozen invariant types in each of two splits; a candidate requires the same type in both splits. No additional field relation may be promoted under this manifest.
kill_conditions: Either split has fewer than 50000 complete rows
No invariant type independently violates the gate in both splits
Provider documentation identifies the apparent contradiction as allowed semantics
allowed_alternates: A failed invariant may become a documented parser or semantics catch
Other NEO/fireball questions require a new manifest because predicted close approaches and atmospheric bolides do not share a simple one-to-one normal
forbidden_changes: No tolerance changes after target inspection
No interpreting a catalog contradiction as physical motion
No unmatched-fireball claim without a separately justified completeness model
